059/**
060 * A class used for initialization of Turbine without a servlet container.
061 * <p>
062 * If you need to use Turbine outside of a servlet container, you can
063 * use this class for initialization of the Turbine servlet.
064 * </p>
065 *
066 * <pre>
067 * TurbineConfig config = new TurbineConfig(".", "conf/TurbineResources.properties");
068 * </pre>
069 *
070 * <p>
071 * All paths referenced in TurbineResources.properties and the path to
072 * the properties file itself (the second argument) will be resolved
073 * relative to the directory given as the first argument of the constructor,
074 * here - the directory where application was started. Don't worry about
075 * discarding the references to objects created above. They are not needed,
076 * once everything is initialized.
077 * </p>
078 *
079 * <p>
080 * In order to initialize the Services Framework outside of the Turbine Servlet,
081 * you need to call the <code>init()</code> method. By default, this will
082 * initialize the Resource and Logging Services and any other services you
083 * have defined in your TurbineResources.properties file.
084 * </p>
085 *
086 * TODO Make this class enforce the lifecycle contracts
087 * 
088 * @see <a href="https://jakarta.ee/specifications/servlet/6.1/jakarta-servlet-spec-6.1">Java Servlet Spec v6.1</a>
089 *
090 * @author <a href="mailto:quintonm@bellsouth.net">Quinton McCombs</a>
091 * @author <a href="mailto:krzewski@e-point.pl">Rafal Krzewski</a>
092 * @author <a href="mailto:jon@latchkey.com">Jon S. Stevens</a>
093 * @author <a href="mailto:dlr@collab.net">Daniel Rall</a>
094 * @author <a href="mailto:hps@intermeta.de">Henning P. Schmiedehausen</a>
095 * @author <a href="mailto:epugh@upstate.com">Eric Pugh</a>
096 * @version $Id$
097 */
098public class TurbineConfig

139    /**
140     * Constructs a new TurbineConfig.
141     *
142     * This is the general form of the constructor. You can provide
143     * a path to search for files, and a name-value map of init
144     * parameters.
145     *
146     * <p> For the list of recognized init parameters, see
147     * {@link org.apache.turbine.Turbine} class.
148     *
149     * @param path The web application root (i.e. the path for file lookup).
150     * @param attributes Servlet container (or emulator) attributes.
151     * @param initParams initialization parameters.
152     */
153    public TurbineConfig(String path, Map<String, Object> attributes,
154            Map<String, String> initParams)
155    {
156        root = new File(path);
157        this.attributes = attributes;
158        this.initParams = initParams;
159    }
160
161    /**
162     * Constructs a new TurbineConfig.
163     *
164     * This is the general form of the constructor. You can provide
165     * a path to search for files, and a name-value map of init
166     * parameters.
167     *
168     * <p> For the list of recognized init parameters, see
169     * {@link org.apache.turbine.Turbine} class.
170     *
171     * @param path The web application root (i.e. the path for file lookup).
172     * @param initParams initialization parameters.
173     */
174    public TurbineConfig(String path, Map<String, String> initParams)
175    {
176        this(path, new HashMap<>(0), initParams);
177    }
178
179    /**
180     * Constructs a TurbineConfig.
181     *
182     * This is a specialized constructor that allows to configure
183     * Turbine easily in the common setups.
184     *
185     * Check also {@link TurbineXmlConfig} to load a {@link #CONFIGURATION_PATH_KEY}.
186     *
187     * @param path The web application root (i.e. the path for file lookup).
188     * @param properties the relative path to TurbineResources.properties file
189     */
190    public TurbineConfig(String path, String properties)
191    {
192        this(path, new HashMap<String, String>(1));
193        initParams.put(PROPERTIES_PATH_KEY, properties);
194    }
195
196    /**
197     * Causes this class to initialize itself which in turn initializes
198     * all of the Turbine Services that need to be initialized.
199     */
200    @Override
201    public void initialize()
202    {
203        try
204        {
205            turbine = new Turbine();
206            turbine.init(this);
207        }
208        catch (Exception e)
209        {
210            log.error("TurbineConfig: Initialization failed", e);
211        }
212    }
213
214    /**
215     * Initialization requiring a HTTP <code>GET</code> request.
216     * @param data the Turbine request
217     */
218    public void init(RunData data)
219    {
220        if (turbine != null)
221        {
222            turbine.init(data);
223        }
224    }
225
226    /**
227     * Shutdown the Turbine System, lifecycle style
228     *
229     */
230    @Override
231    public void dispose()
232    {
233        if (turbine != null)
234        {
235            turbine.destroy();
236        }
237    }

260    /**
261     * Translates a path relative to the web application root into an
262     * absolute path.
263     *
264     * @param path A path relative to the web application root.
265     * @return An absolute version of the supplied path, or <code>null</code>
266     * if the translated path doesn't map to a file or directory.
267     */
268    @Override
269    public String getRealPath(String path)
270    {
271        String result = null;
272        File f = new File(root, path);
273
274        if (log.isDebugEnabled())
275        {
276            log.debug("TurbineConfig.getRealPath: path '{}' translated to '{}' {}found",
277                    path, f.getPath(), f.exists() ? "" : "not ");
278        }
279
280        if (f.exists())
281        {
282          result = f.getPath();
283        }
284        else
285        {
286            log.error("getRealPath(\"{}\") is undefined, returning null", path);
287        }
288
289        return result;
290    }

354        /**
355     * Returns a URL to the resource that is mapped to a specified
356     * path. The path must begin with a "/" and is interpreted
357     * as relative to the current context root.
358     *
359     * @param s the path to the resource
360     * @return a URL pointing to the resource
361     * @throws MalformedURLException if unable to parse path
362     */
363    @Override
364    public URL getResource(String s)
365            throws MalformedURLException
366    {
367        return new URL("file://" + getRealPath(s));
368    }
369
370    /**
371     * Returns the resource located at the named path as
372     * an <code>InputStream</code> object.
373     *
374     * @param s the path to the resource
375     * @return an InputStream object from which the resource can be read
376     */
377    @Override
378    public InputStream getResourceAsStream(String s)
379    {
380        try
381        {
382            FileInputStream fis = new FileInputStream(getRealPath(s));
383            return new BufferedInputStream(fis);
384        }
385        catch (FileNotFoundException e)
386        {
387            return null;
388        }
389    }
